networkAccess.reasoning: Creates Azure DevOps work items from a selected frame. Optional AI Draft sends frame name, native Figma annotations, and visible text-layer copy (no images) to the user's chosen LLM provider (Anthropic, OpenAI, or Azure OpenAI on the user's own tenant) using their own API key. api.notion.com is included because a Notion provider also ships in the bundle but is not promoted in the listing; it is only contacted if a user enables it from Settings. No third-party servers.
